issue: skʷént/h₂ǵént 3pl root aorists, ḱunéy dat., ḱwón voc., enclitic nos/wos and méne moy … dédeh₃ti all correct; bʰéh₂t impf. 'was not speaking' matches.
Fem. h₁íh₂m̥ anticipates nókʷts; ḱéleti 'covers' / mid. ḱéletor 'hides' (*ḱel-); h₁ésyeh₂s gen./abl. 'from it'. Generic neuter kʷíd h₁íd 'what is it?' is idiomatic.
Dual agreement throughout (gʷm̥tā́m, stundtā́m, gʷh₂tā́m); h₂pó gʷh₂dʰí, h₁énos 'that (ram)'. Loc. sruméni with a motion verb is the Vedic-type locative of goal; 'both' is carried by the dual.

linkʷtés is not a form of *leykʷ- (no such cell; looks like a 2/3du ending on a mangled stem). The nasal present 3sg linékʷti 'leaves' is required, parallel to gʷm̥sḱéti. Flagged in the blind pass before the English was seen.
Tier 1 transcription in a laryngeal-less, accentless orthography (owis, eḱwobʰyos, eweket, angʰetai, aǵontm̥) that clashes with corpus notation; faithful to its source, not a grammar error.
spr̥dʰí/spért 'free' (LIV *sper-), skélHt 'slit', h₁ért 'came', subj. déh₃oh₂ 'I shall give' vs u-aorist déh₃wm̥ 'I gave' — all lexicon-backed and correct; fem. h₁íh₂m̥ for the bird.
h₁yód + aor. subj. légʰeti; voc. gʰóstey, dat. gʰostéyey, poh₂imnéy; masc. só for the dog. Correct.

Subject of the final clause is wl̥kʷih₂bʰós (dat./abl. pl.) for 'the she-wolf lay'; nom. sg. wl̥kʷíh₂s is required (as in the first sentence). Separately, h₁ésmōd kʷid h₁éǵʰs gʷm̥sḱéti lacks ne, so the PIE says 'something goes out of it' against English 'Nothing goes out of it' (plan error in t028-0014, fixed). mē gʷm̥yṓh₂ 'I shall not come near' is hortative 'let me not' (engine: neg+SBJV.1 → mē).

Gnomic aorist déh₃ut for 'gives' (accepted convention; déh₃ut is an aorist-only lexeme); ptcp. dat. wr̥ǵyóntey, mid. ptcp. ḱéym̥h₁nōy agreeing with suHnówey; h₂wést 'it has dawned', voc. h₂nér + sth₂dʰí.
Masc. h₁ím for masc. h₂ébōl; h₁wésu neuter with wékʷos; bʰh₂dʰí; ḱlḗm (Stang 1sg, accepted t021); perfect lelóykʷe 'is gone' per lexicon gloss.
Tier 1 transcription: parenthesised -bʰ(y)os, cover-symbol H (Hegʰnutór, Héǵontm̥, Hnérm̥), weukʷét and tu clash with corpus notation; faithful to source.
Perfect stestóh₂e 'was standing', subj. h₁éyoh₂, collective pornéh₂ with sg. verb, loc. dʰǵʰémi, abl. pr̥wéns; fem. h₁íh₂m̥ for the bird. Correct.
kapyéte is 2pl; the subject is h₂nḗr, so 3sg kapyéti is needed (the answer sentence has it).

h₁opéyetes is 2/3du for 'I give you my oath' (speaker = the snake); 1sg h₁opéyoh₂ is needed. Also minor: mē te moréyōh₂ 'I shall not kill you' reads as hortative 'let me not kill you' (engine rule neg+SBJV.1 → mē).
Riddle opens with anaphoric h₁éy for the hidden referent (masc., matching h₂ébōl); acceptable riddle convention (see report). h₂wékst gnomic/aorist, stative h₁rudʰéh₁ti, h₁opéyeti 'hands over'.
Participles légʰyonts/bʰéwdʰonts, perfect bʰebʰówdʰe 'is alert', Narten h₁ḗdti. Correct.
Ins. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁ + mid. woséyeto 'clothed himself'; acc. of goal with h₁r̥sḱét; voc. pl. + 2pl imp.; neuter swóm with dénḱtrom; ḱéleti 'hides'/woydéyeti 'shows'. Correct.

Goal h₁íd is neuter, so in PIE it can only refer to the rock (pr̥wéni), while the story (and the other bird fables, h₁íh₂m̥) means the feminine bird h₂éwis. Plan forces gender n; fixed to f. Rest correct (kúdʰe, h₂isḱóh₂, dʰrugʰyési).
ǵʰóstom (acc.) is subject of sékʷetor 'the hand follows'; nom. ǵʰóstos is required (the next sentence has it).
Gnomic aorist térdt; ins. h₂n̥réh₁ 'by force' (lexicon sense 'power, force'), ins. h₂yúh₁ 'by long time', abl. sruméns, imp. h₁ukdʰí. Correct.
Fem. séh₂/h₁íh₂m̥/h₁íh₂ consistently for the bird; h₁yód + aor. subj. h₁éreti; voc. ph₂ter + ǵn̥h₃dʰí. Answer pronoun h₁íh₂ resolves to the riddle's séh₂.
Dual bʰréh₂terh₁e … dówsih₁ (neuter du. of n. *dóws), lewbʰéh₂ fem. Correct.
polh₁éwes … lewbʰṓs, loc. péḱesi/h₂égʰesi, mid. nasal pres. ǵn̥nh₃tór, mē + injunctive. Correct.
Abl. ph₂wéns/ḱóymōd, mid. ǵn̥h₁yétor, masc. h₁ím for dʰuh₂mós. Correct.
h₁yód correlative, accented h₁ésti, abl. ḱóymōd, mid. ḱéletor 'hides itself'. Correct.
Dat. wiHrṓy, fem. h₁íh₂m̥ anticipating h₂ówis. Correct.
Tier 1 line (The King and the God): a-colouring spelling gʷah₂t, km̥tá; faithful to source, notation clash only.
kʷíd/péh₂wr̥ neuter with 3sg; ne-kʷe; gnomic aorist mért (accepted t021). Correct.
